description: Implement the EXECUTION layer of LTX23_Director_OriginalGraph_Colab.py (CELLS 11-19): the memory manager (CELL 12) lifted as INFRASTRUCTURE from V2's CELL 7, the ComfyUI node registry (CELL 11), the memory-aware execute_node()/call_comfy_node() compatibility layer (CELL 15) that topologically executes the parsed graph on the REAL registered ComfyUI node classes, component loading (CELL 13), LTXDirector master-timeline initialization (CELL 14), final decode (CELL 16), VHS_VideoCombine (CELL 17), output validation (CELL 18) and display/download (CELL 19). Also implement the crash-recovery checkpoint system (workflow_state.json), the Section-35 structured error reporting, and the topological scheduler that respects the 65 links and executes nodes in dependency order. This layer requires torch/comfy/CUDA at Colab runtime and CANNOT be executed in-sandbox; it must remain py_compile-clean and must NOT break the FEAT-001 `--validate-only` stdlib path.
steps: CELL 12 Memory manager (INFRASTRUCTURE from V2 lines 480-699, do NOT copy any workflow logic): malloc_trim_os() via ctypes.CDLL('libc.so.6').malloc_trim(0); get_ram_free_gb() via psutil.virtual_memory().available/1e9; get_vram_free_gb() via torch.cuda.mem_get_info(); drop_page_cache() via os.posix_fadvise POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED over the model dir globs; purge_deep()/deep_memory_cleanup() calling comfy.model_management.unload_all_models()+cleanup_models()+soft_empty_cache(), clearing current_loaded_models, gc.collect(), torch.cuda.empty_cache()+ipc_collect(), malloc_trim, drop_page_cache; memory_guard(min_free_ram_gb=2.0, vram_buffer_gb=1.2) that runs cleanup before expensive stages and logs RAM/VRAM. Make thresholds module-level configurable constants MIN_FREE_RAM_GB=2.0, VRAM_BUFFER_GB=1.2. All functions must degrade gracefully (no crash) when torch/psutil absent so the file stays importable, but they are only CALLED on Colab.

CELL 11 Node registry: after ComfyUI + custom nodes are importable, build NODE_REGISTRY mapping the JSON node 'type' string -> the real registered ComfyUI node CLASS (use ComfyUI's nodes.NODE_CLASS_MAPPINGS plus custom node mappings, including the literal key 'Power Lora Loader (rgthree)'). Provide resolve_node_class(node_type) that RAISES the Section-25 hard error (ORIGINAL WORKFLOW NODE MISSING: <type> / Required custom node: <repo> / install instructions) if a type is not registered. NO silent substitution.

CELL 15 execute_node()/call_comfy_node(): instantiate the exact original node class, read its FUNCTION attribute to find the method name, map the parsed inputs (from resolved upstream link outputs) and widgets_values to the node's INPUT_TYPES-declared argument names in the correct order, call the method, and normalize the ComfyUI return convention (tuple/list/dict, {'result':...}, {'ui':...,'result':...}). Preserve output slot ordering. Log per Section 24 exactly: '[Node <id>] <type>' + RAM/VRAM before, 'Executing...', RAM/VRAM after. Reuse V2's unwrap_tensor/gv/unwrap_latent/sync_latent_device helpers (lift as infra). NEVER swap in a different node; NEVER `except Exception: pass` around core execution (user Section 25/35 forbid it).

Topological executor: from the 65 parsed links build a dependency graph and produce an execution order that terminates at the two sink nodes (VAEDecode=1 -> images, LTXVAudioVAEDecode=24 -> audio, feeding VHS_VideoCombine=139). Execute each node once via execute_node, caching outputs by (node_id, slot). Call memory_guard() before expensive nodes (UnetLoaderGGUF 135, LTXVLatentUpsampler 14, SamplerCustomAdvanced 19/31, VAEDecode 1) and deep_memory_cleanup() after model-heavy stages. Do NOT reorder or fuse in a way that changes semantics; execution order must be derived from the JSON links, not a hand-written 5-segment loop.

CELL 13 Load original graph components: drive the loader nodes (UnetLoaderGGUF 135, Power Lora Loader 138 with all 4 LoRAs+strengths, ModelPreviewOverrideKJ 10, DualCLIPLoader 12, VAELoader 8/36, VAELoaderKJ 6, LatentUpscaleModelLoader 13) through execute_node with lazy/memory-aware loading. The Power Lora Loader must apply all four LoRAs with strengths 0.4/0.6/0.7/0.9 exactly (from parsed widgets_values, node 138). If the rgthree node genuinely cannot execute, implement a clearly-documented compatibility fallback that preserves identical graph semantics and all four strengths (user Section 6) - and log that the fallback was used (no silent degrade).

CELL 14 LTXDirector master timeline init: execute node 131 (LTXDirector) via execute_node with inputs model(from ModelPreviewOverrideKJ 10), clip(from Power Lora Loader 138), audio_vae(from VAELoader 8), passing the parsed serialized timeline widgets so it produces the 8 outputs (model, positive, video_latent, audio_latent, guide_data, motion_guide_data, frame_rate, combined_audio). These outputs feed the rest of the graph. DO NOT replace with EmptyLTXVLatentVideo/manual audio latents (user Section 21) and DO NOT invent a 5-scene loop.

Wire Stage 1 and Stage 2 exactly per the parsed links: Stage 1 = LTXDirectorGuide 132 (strength 1.0) -> CFGGuider 17 -> LTXVConcatAVLatent 18 -> SamplerCustomAdvanced 19 (sampler euler via KSamplerSelect 20, sigmas via BasicScheduler 21 linear_quadratic 8 steps... NOTE: confirm from parsed data which BasicScheduler/KSamplerSelect feed which stage via links, do not assume) with LTXVSeparateAVLatent + LTXDirectorCropGuides 54. Stage 2 = LTXVLatentUpsampler 14 -> LTXDirectorGuide 133 (strength 0.5) -> CFGGuider 28 -> LTXVConcatAVLatent 29 -> SamplerCustomAdvanced 31, LTXVSeparateAVLatent + LTXDirectorCropGuides 55. Both guide stages receive guide_data AND motion_guide_data from LTXDirector. All connections derived from the parsed 65 links, not hardcoded assumptions.

CELL 16 decode: VAEDecode 1 (video VAE 36) -> IMAGE; LTXVAudioVAEDecode 24 (audio VAE 8) -> AUDIO. CELL 17: VHS_VideoCombine 139 with frame_rate from LTXDirector.frame_rate, images from VAEDecode, audio from LTXVAudioVAEDecode, and the exact widget params (frame_rate 24, filename_prefix 'LTX2.3/Video', format 'video/h264-mp4', pix_fmt 'yuv420p', crf 8, save_metadata false, trim_to_audio false, pingpong false, save_output true).

CELL 18 output validation: verify the produced MP4 exists, report measured frame count, duration, RAM peak, VRAM peak, execution time (user Section 40 honesty - no 'guaranteed no crash'). CELL 19: display/download the final MP4 in Colab (IPython display + files.download guarded to Colab).

Crash recovery (user Section 34): implement checkpoint save/load of workflow_state.json {current_node, phase, completed_nodes, output_paths, timeline_state, error_state}; skip re-executing completed expensive nodes when resuming. Structured error reporting (Section 35): on any node failure print Node id/type/function/input types/model loaded/free RAM/free VRAM/stage/traceback and re-raise (no swallowing).

Replace the FEAT-001 NotImplementedError stubs in CELLS 11-19 with the real implementations. Keep the module import-safe without torch (guarded), so `python3 -m py_compile` and the FEAT-001 `--validate-only` path still work in-sandbox.

Run `python3 -m py_compile LTX23_Director_OriginalGraph_Colab.py` and re-run `python3 LTX23_Director_OriginalGraph_Colab.py --validate-only` to confirm both still pass (execution layer must not regress the validator path).
acceptance_criteria: CELLS 11-19 are fully implemented (no NotImplementedError, no TODO, no pseudocode, no `except Exception: pass` around core execution).
`python3 LTX23_Director_OriginalGraph_Colab.py --validate-only` STILL prints all-PASS and exits 0 (execution layer is guarded and does not require torch to import the module).
execute_node logs per-node RAM/VRAM before/after and resolves node classes from a real registry; missing node types raise the Section-25 hard error.

The executor derives order from the parsed 65 links (topological), executes LTXDirector node 131 as the timeline controller, and wires Stage 1 (guide 1.0, 8 steps, denoise 1.0) and Stage 2 (guide 0.5, 4 steps, denoise 0.42) from the parsed graph. No 5-segment loop, no linear_blend_overlap, no per-scene empty latents, no post-only ffmpeg mux.
Memory infra (memory_guard, deep_memory_cleanup, malloc_trim, page-cache drop, 2.0GB RAM / 1.2GB VRAM thresholds) present as infrastructure only.
Checkpoint/resume (workflow_state.json) and structured error reporting implemented.
verification: cd /projects/sandbox/code && python3 LTX23_Director_OriginalGraph_Colab.py --validate-only ; echo EXIT=$? (expect all-PASS, EXIT=0)
grep confirm no `except Exception:\n    pass` around execute_node core and no linear_blend_overlap / per-scene EmptyLTXVLatentVideo loop as primary architecture.
NOTE: full GPU execution (model download, ComfyUI node run, MP4 render) CANNOT be verified in-sandbox (no GPU/ComfyUI/models); must be reported as 'requires real Colab T4 run'.
findings: Implemented CELLS 11-19 of LTX23_Director_OriginalGraph_Colab.py, replacing all NotImplementedError stubs. CELL 11 NodeRegistry.resolve_node_class raises the Section-25 hard error (with the providing custom-node repo) on any missing node type; build_node_registry imports ComfyUI's aggregated NODE_CLASS_MAPPINGS + init_extra_nodes and calls verify_required_node_classes. CELL 12 memory manager is INFRASTRUCTURE-only, lifted from V2 CELL 7 (malloc_trim_os via libc, get_ram_free_gb via psutil, get_vram_free_gb via torch.cuda.mem_get_info, drop_page_cache via os.posix_fadvise over model globs, patch_comfy_memory_manager with VRAM_BUFFER_GB margin, deep_memory_cleanup, memory_guard) with module-level MIN_FREE_RAM_GB=2.0 / VRAM_BUFFER_GB=1.2; unwrap_tensor/gv/unwrap_latent/sync_latent_device lifted as infra with torch imported lazily so the module stays importable without torch. CELL 15 GraphExecutor builds a Kahn topological order from the parsed 65 links (link tuple order [link_id, from_node, from_slot, to_node, to_slot, type]), executes each node ONCE via execute_node()->_call_comfy_node() against the REAL registered class: reads FUNCTION, maps link-resolved input slots + widgets_values (list positional OR dict-by-name for VHS_VideoCombine node 139) to INPUT_TYPES arg names in order, normalizes ComfyUI returns (tuple/list/dict/{'result':...}/{'ui':...}) to {slot:value}. Per-node RAM/VRAM logged before+after (Section 24); memory_guard() before expensive nodes {135,14,19,31,1,24} and deep_memory_cleanup() after. On failure it prints the Section-35 structured report (node id/type/function/input types/free RAM/free VRAM/traceback) and RE-RAISES as GraphExecutionError (no silent swallow). CELL 13 drives loader nodes through the executor; the rgthree Power Lora Loader has a DOCUMENTED, LOGGED fallback to builtin LoraLoader preserving all four LoRA strengths 0.4/0.6/0.7/0.9 (never silent). CELL 14 executes LTXDirector node 131 as master timeline controller (8 outputs), NOT replaced with EmptyLTXVLatentVideo/manual latents and NOT a 5-scene loop. CELL 16 reads VAEDecode 1 + LTXVAudioVAEDecode 24 outputs; CELL 17 executes VHS_VideoCombine 139 as the primary A/V mux; CELL 18 validate_output reports measured MP4 size/duration/frames + RAM/VRAM/time (Section 40 honesty, no 'guaranteed no crash'); CELL 19 display_download guarded to Colab. CheckpointManager persists workflow_state.json {current_node,phase,completed_nodes,output_paths,timeline_state,error_state} and skips re-executing completed nodes on resume. Added run_full_pipeline() driver and a --run entrypoint (refused outside Colab). VERIFIED IN-SANDBOX: `python3 -m py_compile` exits 0; `python3 ... --validate-only` STILL prints all-9-PASS Section-27 report and exits 0 (execution layer fully guarded, torch/comfy/psutil imported lazily inside functions; module import-safe without them; Python 3.9 compatible). grep confirms no linear_blend_overlap / EmptyLTXVLatentVideo / 5-segment loop except in forbidden-arch comments, and the only `except Exception: pass` blocks are memory-infra graceful-degradation (VRAM query, CUDA cache cleanup), NOT around core execute_node (which re-raises). NOT VERIFIABLE IN-SANDBOX (requires real Colab T4, no GPU/ComfyUI/CUDA/torch/multi-GB models here): actual GPU node execution, model/LoRA/audio downloads, LTXDirector output shapes, ComfyUI INPUT_TYPES arg-name-vs-slot mapping against the real node classes, and final MP4 render. These paths are written to the documented ComfyUI conventions but cannot be proven crash-free without a live runtime.
